reason: Record the bounded first-class Deepgram speech provider implementation.

operation.summary: Added typed Deepgram batch synthesis and prerecorded transcription support with canonical profiles, redacted provenance, deterministic loopback proof, one bounded live canary, and downstream Podcast Studio guidance.
changes: Added typed synthesis/transcription requests, results, media settings, provenance, stable errors, and a speech-provider factory.
Added Deepgram Aura-2 Pluto and Nova-3 profiles without implying text-completion support.
Restricted live credentials to per-request environment or external key-file resolution and official Deepgram endpoints.
Added deterministic loopback tests plus a redacted Pluto/Nova-3 live receipt.
Documented provider setup and Podcast Studio consumption without duplicating HTTP or credential ownership.
